_note_routing: The routing map: each seat once, with its real GitHub login (App seats as their bot login, people by handle; null = no GitHub login, reached in the inner loop only), its nicknames as aliases, and role, plane, and primary. planes names each plane's primary when that seat lives on another plane, plus the overflow order. burst-live resolves every login against GitHub at startup and on each audit, refuses an unresolved entry and flags it on the board; GET /routing serves it read-only. Look a login up there before you @-mention anyone, never from memory. Logins verified against the GitHub users API: forge0x1[bot], critic0x[bot], herald0x[bot], arch10x[bot], near10x[bot]. blinky and mill have no App login (null).

reviewer._note: pr_heads sends critic + blinky one line per new PR / head

arch1.reason: explicit @arch10x ask for Arch1 (outside the fleet)

forge.reason: CI / deploy failure, merge / deploy / Gate B run ask, implement / rebase / dev ask, or merge into main or bifrost/main; terminal railway deploy (op_deploy). Forge launches the cloud agent.

critic.reason: review request or Light / Strict / re-Light ask

blinky.reason: mention for blinky (wave plan, burn, Lane H, onboarding)

seats.critic: review ask: new PR or new head
seats.blinky: heads-up: new PR or new head

_note_pr_heads: every PR open / new head on a watched repo, mention or not; one line per seat per repo#number@sha (inbox_pass.py)
_note_handoffs: Who the packet goes to, and who owes sending it, for live-inbox --handoff. reviewer and merger name seats in this file. author is the PR author's seat. The server never posts the packet. A room post does not clear a missed handoff.
_note_extra_seats: extra_seats are routed by feed/inbox_pass.py (kinds / merge_bases / needles); every key is one of our 9 seats (feed/fleet-roster.json)
_note_builder_cloud: builder / builder-cloud are kit plumbing in app/server.mjs (installation-token auth, mirror); no route writes to them
_note_fallback: Actionable events whose lines all go to a seat outside our 9 (unknown, sample, unkeyed) also go to blinky (CoS). Lines to seats outside our 9 are dropped. Pulses never route. A mention reaches arch1 only by an explicit @arch10x. Packet R assigns him without that mention: R: arch1 is his queue line and is not copied to blinky.
_note_comment_watch: Every PR/issue comment (incl. merged PRs) routes to blinky, and PR/issue comments also to the PR or issue author's seat (aliases on the author node), mention or not. @-mentions come from the collector's mentions[] (handles only, never bodies).
_note_seats: seats: the kit's role rules (reviewer / builder / tester / operator / coord, read by routing/inbox.py), each mapped to one of our 9 by "seat" (or "off"); inbox_pass.py rewrites every line to that seat. Kit defaults stay in inbox.py.
